equipment_trigger: unique registered active equipment decoded from camera pixels under explicit camera-equipment source policy
repeated_same_equipment: presence evidence; never an end toggle
equipment_switch: new operation phase, not whole-experiment completion
operation_boundaries: QR and source-pinned reviewed oral stage anchors; missing or ambiguous anchor stays explicit
unbound_activity: independent experimental/value/unknown classification; speech or static pixels alone are insufficient
model_context: bounded historical prior and contemporaneous ASR/OCR/source-QR evidence in actual model input; source and knowledge clocks pinned
current_input_dependencies: wait for already submitted overlapping, calibrated, same-camera ASR/OCR/QR tasks; missing channels not fabricated
daily_report: versioned database projection with evidence references; prior reports are derived history, never new physical actions
